newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians stone Israeli troops in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians stone Israeli troops in Hebron.

text.p: Palestinian stone-throwers clashed with Israeli soldiers in Hebron on Friday in a seventh straight day of violence in the divided West Bank town, witnesses said.
They said about 60 Israeli soldiers were firing rubber bullets at some 100 youths who threw stones or fired slingshots at troops across the invisible line dividing the West Bank town.

More than 100 Palestinians have been shot and wounded by rubber bullets in six days of violence along the dividing line. Several Israeli soldiers have been hurt. The clashes erupted over a U.S. congressional vote demanding that the administration recognise Arab East Jerusalem as part of Israel's capital.

The clashes underscored tensions over a three-month impasse in Israeli-Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) peace moves and Israel's expansion of Jewish settlement in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank, including Arab East Jerusalem.

Israel handed over 80 percent of Hebron, the southernmost West Bank city, to Palestinian self-rule in January but kept troops behind to guard some 400 Jewish settlers living or studying in the remaining 20 percent.
